text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, a data analyst with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’d love to help with your media buying analysis project. In a recent Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work led to 18% of the ad budget being reallocated and helped reduce customer acquisition cost by 12% the next quarter.

I’m comfortable building clean databases, surfacing patterns in complex datasets, and turning findings into clear dashboards and recommendations. What data sources are you currently using for your media buying analysis?
